title: CALL is macro-sheet-only (refused on worksheets) and defaults omitted arguments to 0 while coercing logicals in XLM
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit), CALL(register_id, [argument1], ...) is valid only on Excel 4.0 macro sheets (XLM): assigning any CALL formula to a worksheet cell throws 0x800A03EC (all CALL worksheet-entry probes refused), and opening a saved package holding CALL or _xlfn.CALL fails with 0x800A03EC. Under Application.ExecuteExcel4Macro, CALL accepts either a registration ID from REGISTER.ID or inline (module_text, procedure, type_text, ...), passes omitted trailing arguments as 0, coerces logicals to numbers (TRUE -> 1), takes the first element of an array literal, returns FALSE when extra arguments exceed the signature, and returns #VALUE! on text or error arguments where numeric type codes apply.
basis: Measured across all worksheet entry checks, package open checks, and XLM evaluations in Excel 16.0.20527 (64-bit) recorded in call-register-id-excel.json (dc-gh22).
